sous_titre: Croissance annuelle moyenne prévue de 2026 à 2035, en pourcentage

series.nom: Croissance annuelle moyenne prévue de la pointe

Été, conditions normales.texte: Under typical summer weather conditions, net peak demand is expected to rise at an annual rate of 0.6%.

Été, conditions chaudes.texte: For hotter weather, the net peak is expected to rise by 0.7% annually.

Hiver, conditions normales.texte: Under typical winter conditions, net peak demand is expected to rise by an average of 2.6% annually.

Hiver, conditions froides.texte: For colder weather, the net peak is expected to increase by 2.9% annually.
